description: If \(x\in\operatorname{FV}(t)\) and \(t\ne x\), no substitution, into any residual variable alphabet, satisfies \(\sigma(x)=t[\sigma]\).
signature:
Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.TermUnification.occurs_obstruction.{u, v, w} {L : FirstOrder.Language} {α : Type w} (x : ℕ)
  (t : L.Term ℕ) (hx : x ∈ t.varFinset) (hne : t ≠ FirstOrder.Language.var x) (σ : ℕ → L.Term α) : σ x ≠ t.subst σ
